about: Model and dataset names that differ by a number (ResNet-18 / ResNet-34 / ResNet-50 / ResNet-101, CIFAR-10 / CIFAR-100, VGG-16 / VGG-19) and separate training, validation and test charts.

claims.sentence: ResNet-18 reaches 94.1% training accuracy at epoch 10.
ResNet-18 reaches 84.0% validation accuracy at epoch 10.
ResNet-50 reaches 96.4% validation accuracy at epoch 10.
claims.why: 96.4 is the TRAINING value; validation is 88.5

claims.sentence: ResNet-34 reaches 86.0% validation accuracy at epoch 10.
claims.why: ResNet-34 is not plotted (the old matching read ResNet-18 or ResNet-50 instead)

claims.sentence: VGG-19 reaches 79.5% validation accuracy at epoch 10.
claims.why: VGG-19 is not plotted, only VGG-16 (whose value is 79.5)

claims.sentence: ResNet-50 reaches 89.0% test accuracy at epoch 10.
claims.why: no test curve: the curves are training and validation

claims.sentence: On CIFAR-100, ResNet-50 achieves 78.2% test accuracy.

claims.why: 92.1 is CIFAR-10; CIFAR-100 is 70.3 (the old matching read the CIFAR-10 bar)
